description:
Perform Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit root tests on the US macroeconomic dataset 'usa.gdt' (which is already loaded). You must write and execute a script to perform three specific tests:

1. ADF test on 'gdp' (Real GDP) in levels: use 4 lags, include a Constant and Trend.
2. ADF test on the first difference of 'gdp' (growth): use 4 lags, include a Constant only.
3. ADF test on 'inf' (Inflation) in levels: use 4 lags, include a Constant only.

Write your script in the Gretl script editor (File > Script files > New script) and save the output of these tests to a file named '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/adf_results.txt'.

HINT: Use the 'outfile' command in your script to direct output to the file.

metadata.data_source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED database (via Principles of Econometrics 5th Ed)
